name: [⚔️] Kit PVP FFA
desc:
⚔️ KIT PVP – fast block PvP with modern 1.21-style combat!
Pick a kit, drop into the free-for-all arena and fight. Real 1.21 PvP: attack cooldown, crits, sweeping, shields, knockback and armor.

🗡️ 8 KITS: Sword, Mace, Mace & Spear, Elytra & Rockets, TNT, End Crystals, Archer and Orbital Strike
💥 Mace PvP, crystal PvP, respawn anchors, wind charges, spear lunges, elytra mace combos, ender pearls, totems and golden apples
🧱 Build, bridge and blow up the map: it resets every 5 minutes
🔥 Killstreaks, bounties and kill perks like Super Mode
⭐ Level up to 200, then Prestige
🎁 Open crates for skins, sword skins, capes and auras, up to Divine (0.1%)
📅 Daily rewards + a free reward for joining the group
🏆 Climb the Top Kills leaderboard
🎮 PC, phone and controller, with rebindable controls and F5 third person

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Minecraft or Microsoft.
